[[User:Zerah Dacan|Zerah Dacan]] ([[User talk:Zerah Dacan|talk]]) 10:58, 24 November 2020 (UTC)

: I agree. The descriptions should not be interpretations or speculations. If someone wants to assert something you are within your rights to ask for a quote stating "Egwene was not wearing a green dress" that explicitly shows what the facts were or part of an internal monologue to show the character genuinely did believe something. There is also a PoV trap to beware if a certain character thinks "Egwene is such a bitch", then that statement should be framed about who is thinking that "Sheriam thought Egwene was a bitch", for example. In general, there are ways of dealing with these statements that operate on the main Wikipedia site. They would call it NPOV, UNDUE or mark to clarify who is making the statement.
